name: gcp-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configuration for Google Cloud Platform tools. Enables autonomous AI agents to inspect Cloud Run services/revisions, fetch Cloud Logging error logs, retrieve Secret Manager payloads, and inspect Cloud Pub/Sub topics and subscriptions.

GCP_PROJECT_ID.description: The Google Cloud Project ID hosting Cloud Run, Cloud Logging, Pub/Sub, and Secret Manager.

GCP_REGION.description: Default Google Cloud regional location for Cloud Run services and regional resources.

GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.description: Absolute file path to the service account JSON key file. If omitted, Google Application Default Credentials (ADC) from 'gcloud auth application-default login' is used.

tools.name: cloudrun_list_services
tools.description: List all Google Cloud Run v2 services deployed within the configured project and region.

region.description: GCP region (defaults to configured GCP_REGION if omitted).

tools.name: cloudrun_get_service
tools.description: Inspect detailed specification, active ingress settings, traffic routing percentages, URL, and conditions of a specific Cloud Run service.

service_name.description: Name of the Cloud Run service (e.g., 'task-api', 'task-worker', 'task-web').

tools.name: cloudrun_list_revisions
tools.description: List all active and historical revisions for a specified Cloud Run service.

service_name.description: Name of the Cloud Run service.

limit.description: Maximum number of revisions to return.

tools.name: cloudrun_get_revision
tools.description: Inspect container image tag, CPU/RAM resource limits, concurrency, environment variables, and startup probe configuration of a specific Cloud Run revision.

service_name.description: Name of the Cloud Run service.

tools.name: cloudlogging_fetch_errors
tools.description: Retrieve recent ERROR, CRITICAL, and EMERGENCY severity log entries with stack traces across services.

service_name.description: Filter by Cloud Run service name (e.g., 'task-api'). Optional.

time_window_minutes.description: Time window in minutes to search backward from current timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to retrieve.

tools.name: cloudlogging_query_logs
tools.description: Execute an advanced Cloud Logging filter expression against project logs with timestamp bounds.

filter.description: Cloud Logging filter query (e.g., 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND textPayload=~"panic"').

start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string representing window start.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string representing window end.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching log entries to return.

tools.name: secretmanager_list_secrets
tools.description: List all secrets defined in Google Cloud Secret Manager for the configured project (names, replication, and labels only; payloads are not returned).

page_size.description: Maximum number of secrets to list per page.

tools.name: secretmanager_get_payload
tools.description: Retrieve the decrypted payload of a specific secret version for environment validation or local debug emulation.

tools.name: pubsub_list_topics
tools.description: List all Google Cloud Pub/Sub topics defined within the GCP project.

tools.name: pubsub_get_topic
tools.description: Inspect topic configuration including message retention duration, KMS encryption keys, and schema settings.

tools.name: pubsub_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List all subscriptions attached to a specific Pub/Sub topic, including push endpoints, ack deadlines, and filter policies.

topic_id.description: Pub/Sub topic ID to inspect subscriptions for.

tools.name: pubsub_get_subscription_metrics
tools.description: Retrieve subscription health telemetry including backlog unacknowledged message count, oldest message age, and dead-letter queue config.

security.notes: Do NOT grant Owner or Editor roles to MCP agent credentials. Use dedicated read-only service accounts for inspecting production environments.
